desc: Protect your family and home with the same NFA/Class III pump-actions that protect our streets and borders. The 590A1 Class III features ambidextrous safety; dual extractors; twin action bars; positive steel-to-steel lockup; and an anti-jam elevator ensuring smooth operation. It also has metal trigger guard/safety button; convenient magazine tube clean-out cap; and a forend strap to keep the shooters lead hand clear of the muzzle. This model features a black synthetic stock with a 4 shell holder and ghost ring sights. This shotgun is classified as a NFA firearm.
